portfolio.title: Portfolio Template
portfolio.reason: Highlight your projects interactively with detailed descriptions, collaborators and links. Ultra clean design to let visitors focus on your projects. Expandable "About" section to view your portrait and biography.

portfolio.title: Vertical Template
portfolio.reason: Share your personal information with a professional touch. Present your achievements more clearly by visually showing them with media. Link to the full project for authenticity.

portfolio.title: Big Buck Bunny
portfolio.reason: Blender Foundation initiated this open movie project. A small team (7) of the best 3D artists and developers in the Blender community have been invited to come together to work in Amsterdam from October 2007 until April 2008 on completing a short 3D animation movie.

portfolio.title: Video Fail Loading
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: Preview of a video failing to load
portfolio.reason: Sometimes the video is not available or the link is broken. The website has no timeout and will simply wait for the video to load indefinitely.
